_comment: Template, Claude Code on macOS (environments/claude-code-macos.md): the fragment to MERGE into ~/.claude/settings.json; the other keys of the user's file stay as they are. One way to set it, not a requirement (guide.md). In this file a path is ~/… or //abs — a bare /… would be relative to ~/.claude/. The two ask lines put before the user as a permission prompt, in every mode, every write under ~/.claude and every start of a session by a session. No hooks. The write block (blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories, v2.1.314+) refuses the file tools outside the session's folders and refuses Claude Code settings files to the agent everywhere: once it is on, the user pastes each change to this file themselves and the agent reads it back. The read block (blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories, v2.1.257+) keeps reads to the session's folders. The sandbox runs each Bash command under macOS Seatbelt — writes in the session's folders and temp alone, with the read block reads there alone, no host unless named per command and approved; the four excluded commands run outside it because git's credential comes through gh, whose folder sandboxed commands cannot read. The mcp__ccd_* and Cd lines name tools of the Claude desktop app.
